scope: Shared WSL loopback, native epoll backend, 128-byte body, HTTP/1.1 keepalive. No TLS, capture, ML, response caching or security policy. Nginx buffering disabled. AegisX retains its correlation header and HTTP admission machinery. Not feature parity or isolated capacity.
